name: gpu-vector-add
question: How does vector size change the measured CUDA event interval for float32 addition, and does every output match a rounded float32 CPU reference?
procedure: Generate seeded float32 vectors at two sizes. Run an actual PTX addition kernel with three warmups and seven CUDA-event measurements. Copy results back and compare every element to a float32-rounded CPU reference. Transfers and setup are outside the event interval.
